name: MajoraMod
author: KeroJester
description: Majora's Mask content for Ocarina of Time. So far: all of Majora's Mask's songs as songs of their own (Song of Healing, Song of Soaring, Sonata of Awakening, Goron Lullaby, New Wave Bossa Nova, Elegy of Emptiness, Oath to Order, Inverted Song of Time, Song of Double Time), with their own replay, name, caption and songbook button. Also raises the size table entries other mods request in an rstb.txt (maps made with the Blender map tools). Start the game from Hookshot Mods for it to load. On Longshot, the first launch after installing or updating plays without the songs; they appear from the next launch.
